name: AllTracker
plain: AllTracker (Harley et al., ICCV 2025): track every pixel of a query frame through a whole video offline, as long-range optical flow over 16-frame windows; point queries read the dense result. MIT code and weights.
summary: AllTracker (Harley et al., ICCV 2025): tracking every pixel of a query frame through a video offline, as long-range optical flow. A ConvNeXt (tiny: a residual CNN) encodes every frame at 1/8; 16-frame windows (stride 8) refine the flow and visibility of all anchor pixels to all window frames at once, with a correlation pyramid, 2D ConvNeXt blocks over space and 1D blocks over time, then an 8x convex upsampling. Point queries read the dense result.

papers.title: AllTracker: Efficient Dense Point Tracking at High Resolution

limitations: Offline: the features of every frame are kept in memory (about 2.5 MB per frame in float16 at 384 x 512); each query frame costs a forward pass (and a backward pass from frame 0 if it is not the first).

Frames are resized to 384 x 512 (upstream's default evaluation size), whatever their size and aspect ratio. Upstream reports higher accuracy at larger sizes (TAP-Vid DAVIS AJ 65.9 at 448 x 768, 67.2 at 768 x 1024); the size is a card parameter.
Tracks are sampled bilinearly at the query position; upstream's evaluation rounds the query to the nearest pixel.
One video per call; all queries of a call share the video.
task_io: Input: a video (its frames in order) and query points `(t, x, y)`. Output: the position of every query in every frame and the probability that it is visible there.

variants.name: alltracker

training_data.name: Spring (scene flow / optical flow / stereo, University of Stuttgart)

licence.training_note: Upstream README: stage 1 on Kubric MOVi-F, stage 2 on a mix of point tracking data (Kubric, PointOdyssey, Dynamic Replica and point tracks made from FlyingThings3D, Monkaa, Driving, SPRING) and optical flow data (FlyingChairs, FlyingThings3D, Monkaa, Driving, AutoFlow, SPRING, VIPER, HD1K, KITTI, TartanAir). Kubric, PointOdyssey, Dynamic Replica, AutoFlow and VIPER have no dataset entry here yet ("unstated").

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

kernels.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

original16.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls

quality.title: TAP-Vid DAVIS (query first), every 3rd video, AJ / delta_avg / OA %
quality.protocol: TAP-Vid protocol: frames resized to 256 x 256 (PIL Lanczos) before the model (AllTracker: the original frames, resized by the model), one query per track at its first visible point, tracked online (TAPNext, Track-On) or over the whole clip (TAPIR, AllTracker, LocoTrack); AJ, delta_avg (< 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 px at 256 x 256) and occlusion accuracy averaged over the videos.

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 2.3e-05 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.0019 and p99 <= 0.0099 (absolute error of the output `tracks`).
